note: Every training arm of the study of 17 to 18 November 2026, in the order it was started. Settings are the arguments stored in the arm's checkpoint, without machine paths. The schedule is the launch setting: the learning rate follows a cosine over schedule.steps, and an arm that was stopped early kept that schedule. Curves are read from the training logs. val_bpb scores the weights of the last update and averaged_val_bpb the running weight average, both on the same 16 batches of 8 windows of 512 enwik8 validation bytes. final_validation is the trainer's last evaluation on more batches. One seed, 20001.
